seen_animation: A line-drawn cup seen from above: a double-stroked, many-sided rim, a second larger curve for the body falling away to the lower right, and a loop handle on the left. In frames 1-3 the cup sits high and to the right with the handle hooked upward at upper left; two small grey circles sit below it. Over frames 3-6 the cup slides down into the middle of the frame and the handle swings round to point left and slightly down. Frames 6-13 hold roughly in place with a small drift left and down, the handle now pointing lower-left. In frames 14-16 a cluster of small black zigzag specks appears and grows at the lower right of the cup's floor, inside the rim.
seen_film: A close, top-down shot of a white plastic measuring cup with a pour spout on the left and a printed label, against a dark background with a pale blurred shape at right. In frames 1-3 the cup is high in the frame with the spout at upper left and dark knobs below it; the cup moves down and the spout rotates to point left and down through frames 3-6. Frames 6-13 the cup sits near centre with small drifts, the ridged bottom visible inside. From frame 14 onward dark granules collect in the bottom of the cup and grow into a pile by frame 16, while the cup tilts slightly so the spout rises again.
named_subject: A cup / mug (standing in for the film's measuring cup), with the doodle's loop handle placed where the film's pour spout is
evidence: Judged from still frames only, not playback. e.png 1-8 vs f.png 1-8: the drawn cup moves down and its handle rotates from upper-left to left exactly as the film's spout does, in the same frames; the grey circles in e1-e8 sit where the film's dark knobs are. e8->e9 the cup drops in the frame, matching the film's drop at f8->f9. e15->e17 the cup shifts left and down, matching f15->f17. e17-e37 hold with small drift as the film does. Specks first appear at e38 and grow through e44, matching granules appearing at f37-f39 and piling up through f44, and they sit in the same place (lower right of the cup floor). g.png shows the drawings stacked in one tight overlapping band with the centre markers clustered, with no gaps or reversals. Rim keeps the doodle's double, faceted stroke in every frame with no size pops.
primary_gap: The cup body is not a closed form like the doodle's: the outer body curve ends in a detached straight stroke at the lower right (visible in every frame, e.g. e9-e44), which reads as a stray line rather than the side of the cup.
closes_when: The lower-right body stroke joins the body curve into one continuous wall line that meets the rim, as the doodle's sides meet its rim and base, in every frame.
protect: The timing match with the film (descent and handle rotation in frames 1-8, drop at 8-9, shift at 15-17, specks appearing at 38 and growing); the doodle's double-stroked faceted rim and looped handle; the stable size of the drawing from frame to frame; the specks drawn as small zigzag marks in the doodle's line style rather than filled texture.
identity_gap: The rim and handle carry the doodle's stroke habits, but the doodle's simple closed side walls and flat base are replaced by an open body curve with a loose straight stroke at the lower right.
